name: Graph Paper Cream
used_by: style S06 (engine/styles/S06-statue-graph-paper.prompt.md): interiors bake from this template, Codex paints only the statue cover plate
vibe: Editorial / list-y / value-stack on warm cream graph paper
when_to_use: Anything where each item has a GitHub repo or product screenshot

placeholders.{{BRAND}}: CTA handle pill (ctaHandle and its fallback); replace with your handle or brand from engine/brand.json when the template is copied into a deck

assets.note: cover.png is the template's sample statue cover (preview only; a deck sets coverImg to its own final/slide-01.png). hero-placeholder.png marks where a capture goes; replace every use before the bake

structure.total_slides: variable (cover + N value + CTA); the sample is 5

cover.source: S06 Codex statue plate (SYSTEM + COVER + KEYING), the real logo tile composited into its cyan slot with shared/composite.py, type from kits/S06/cover.html

value.repo_card: Custom HTML (white, light theme), no avatar

cta.legacy: without ctaKeyword, ctaActions renders a Save / Share / Follow list
cta.fit: the keyword shrinks to fit (never under 96 px); a keyword or deliverable that can't fit makes export.mjs exit 3

tweaks.engine: localStorage keys namespaced by the page path + JSON export, synced by hand into slides[] defaults before the bake
